outcomes.decisionReason: IDENTITY_VERIFIED__EGGPLANT_FATTEH_IS_INDEPENDENTLY_CORROBORATED_AS_A_LEVANTINE_LEBANESE FATTEH VARIANT WITH BREAD_AND_EGGPLANT. The discovery source presented a vegetarian eggplant fatteh. Independent corroboration now includes SBS Food, which identifies eggplant fatteh (fatteh bi batenjan) as a Lebanese form of fatteh and describes fatteh as widely eaten in Lebanon with bread as a defining base, and PBS Food, which independently documents fatteh al-betenjane as an eggplant version within Lebanese cuisine. This resolves the prior exact-variant identity hold. Accepted scope is identity/variant existence and Levantine-Lebanese placement only; it does not establish one definitive recipe, universal structure invariants, exclusive origin, nutrition authority, rights/provenance/safety clearance, app-authoring eligibility or public-export eligibility.
